# Parse all habit tracking notes
import re
from datetime import datetime

# Get all note contents
notes_data = []
for n in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=n['note_id'], access_token=access_token)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in note['content'].splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = habit.strip()
            value = value.strip().lower()
            if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                habits[habit] = value
    notes_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

# Determine habit order from first note (assuming consistent order)
first_habits = list(notes_data[0]['habits'].keys())
print("Habit order:", first_habits)
print("Number of notes:", len(notes_data))
